schema.text: When parking is hard, what do you usually do?

ar.#I change my route or where I go: أغيّر طريقي أو المكان الذي أذهب إليه
ar.#I go another way instead (e.g. bus, on: أذهب بوسيلة أخرى بدلًا من ذلك (مثل الحافلة أو مشيًا)
ar.#I put off, avoid or cancel some trips: أؤجل بعض الرحلات أو أتجنبها أو ألغيها
ar.#I still go, but it's slower or more str: ما زلت أذهب، لكن الأمر يكون أبطأ أو أكثر إرهاقًا
ar.#When parking is hard, what do you usual: عندما يصعب إيجاد موقف، ماذا تفعل عادةً؟

de.#I change my route or where I go: Ich ändere meine Route oder mein Ziel
de.#I go another way instead (e.g. bus, on: Ich nehme stattdessen ein anderes Verkehrsmittel (z. B. Bus, zu Fuß)
de.#I put off, avoid or cancel some trips: Ich verschiebe, vermeide oder streiche manche Fahrten
de.#I still go, but it's slower or more str: Ich fahre trotzdem hin, aber es dauert länger oder ist stressiger
de.#It doesn't change my plans: Es ändert nichts an meinen Plänen
de.#When parking is hard, what do you usual: Was tun Sie in der Regel, wenn das Parken schwierig ist?

fa.#I change my route or where I go: مسیر یا مقصد خود را تغییر می‌دهم
fa.#I go another way instead (e.g. bus, on: به جای آن با روش دیگری می‌روم (مثلاً اتوبوس، پیاده)
fa.#I put off, avoid or cancel some trips: بعضی سفرها را به تعویق می‌اندازم، از آن‌ها دوری می‌کنم یا لغو می‌کنم
fa.#I still go, but it's slower or more str: باز هم می‌روم، اما کندتر یا با تنش بیشتر
fa.#When parking is hard, what do you usual: وقتی پیدا کردن جای پارک سخت است، معمولاً چه می‌کنید؟

fr.#I change my route or where I go: Je change d'itinéraire ou de destination
fr.#I go another way instead (e.g. bus, on: Je me déplace autrement (p. ex. en bus, à pied)
fr.#I put off, avoid or cancel some trips: Je reporte, j'évite ou j'annule certains trajets
fr.#I still go, but it's slower or more str: J'y vais quand même, mais c'est plus long ou plus stressant
fr.#It doesn't change my plans: Cela ne change pas mes projets
fr.#When parking is hard, what do you usual: Quand il est difficile de se garer, que faites-vous habituellement ?

hu.#I change my route or where I go: Megváltoztatom az útvonalat vagy az úti célt
hu.#I go another way instead (e.g. bus, on: Inkább más módon megyek (pl. busszal, gyalog)
hu.#I put off, avoid or cancel some trips: Néhány utat elhalasztok, elkerülök vagy lemondok
hu.#I still go, but it's slower or more str: Ettől még elmegyek, de lassabb vagy stresszesebb
hu.#When parking is hard, what do you usual: Ha nehéz parkolni, mit szokott tenni?

it.#I go another way instead (e.g. bus, on: Mi sposto in un altro modo (ad es. autobus, a piedi)
it.#I put off, avoid or cancel some trips: Rimando, evito o annullo alcuni spostamenti
it.#I still go, but it's slower or more str: Ci vado lo stesso, ma è più lento o più stressante
it.#When parking is hard, what do you usual: Quando è difficile parcheggiare, cosa fai di solito?

tr.#I go another way instead (e.g. bus, on: Bunun yerine başka bir şekilde giderim (örn. otobüs, yürüyerek)
tr.#I put off, avoid or cancel some trips: Bazı yolculukları ertelerim, yapmaktan kaçınırım veya iptal ederim
tr.#I still go, but it's slower or more str: Yine de giderim ama daha yavaş veya daha stresli olur
tr.#When parking is hard, what do you usual: Park etmek zor olduğunda genellikle ne yaparsınız?
